dialogue.speaker: Director Magnus Netherton
dialogue.text: Cell lead is Michael Reeves, fifteen years an NSA analyst. He designs operations and reads the results. He does not attend.

cmd.fn: async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x => x.offsetParent && /figure it out/i.test(x.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); const mg = window.MinigameFramework; if (mg && mg.currentMinigame) { try { mg.endMinigame(false); } catch (e) {} } await w(250); } return 1; }

() => { if (!document.getElementById("shot-hide-hud")) { const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "shot-hide-hud"; st.textContent = ".objectives-panel, #notification-container, .notification, #npc-bark-container, .npc-interaction-prompt, .phone-access-button, #health-ui-container, #hud-info-label, #scenario-timer-display, #toggle-buttons-container, #music-widget-btn-anchor, #vm-controls-overlay, #inventory-container { display: none !important; }"; document.head.appendChild(st); } return 1; }

async () => { if (!window.rooms['cable_vault']) await window.loadRoom('cable_vault'); const r = window.rooms['cable_vault']; if (!r) return 'not-loaded'; for (const id of ''.split(',').filter(Boolean)) { const n = window.npcManager && window.npcManager.npcs.get(id); if (n && n._sprite) n._sprite.setVisible(true); } const cam = (window.lightingSystem?.scene || window.game).cameras.main; cam.stopFollow(); cam.centerOn(r.position.x + r.map.widthInPixels / 2, r.position.y + r.map.heightInPixels / 2); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400)); const s = window.lightingSystem?.rooms.get('cable_vault'); return s ? (s.on ? 'on' : 'off') : 'no-lighting'; }

async () => { const L = window.lightingSystem; if (!L) return 'no-lighting'; const t = L.lastDraw; await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 300)); const s = L.rooms.get('cable_vault'); return s ? ('mode=' + s.mode + ' variant=' + s.variantIdx + ' lit=#' + s.litAmbient.toString(16) + ' redraw=' + Math.round(L.lastDraw - t) + 'ms') : 'unregistered'; }
